# asyntai_website (Resource)

A website (AI agent) in your Asyntai account. On create, Asyntai reads the site and writes a first draft of the AI instructions, the same as when you add a website in the dashboard.

~> The API has no delete call for websites. `terraform destroy` removes the website from the Terraform state only; the website and its chat history stay in your Asyntai account. Delete it in the dashboard if you want it gone.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "asyntai_website" "shop" {
  domain = "shop.example.com"
  name   = "Shop assistant"
}

# Put this snippet on the site.
output "embed_code" {
  value = asyntai_website.shop.embed_code
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain` (String) Domain of the website, for example `example.com`. Changing it creates a new website.

### Optional

- `allow_duplicate` (Boolean) Create the website even when the account already has the same domain, as a second agent. Defaults to `false`.
- `crawl` (Boolean) Read the site and write the first AI instructions on create. Defaults to `true`. Only used when the website is created.
- `name` (String) Display name of the agent in the dashboard. Changing it creates a new website.

### Read-Only

- `embed_code` (String) The `<script>` snippet to put on the site.
- `id` (String) Website id.
- `is_primary` (Boolean) Whether this is the primary website of the account.
- `widget_id` (String) Widget id, used in the embed code.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import a website by its id (the number in the dashboard URL or from data.asyntai_websites).
terraform import asyntai_website.shop 42
```
